caption: The drawing consists of two main objects rendered in pencil on a beige or off-white paper background. The top object is an oval-shaped container, possibly a box, shown from the side with shading to create a three-dimensional effect, and appearing to have a flat lid with some faint writing or decoration on its surface. Below this, the second object is an oval-shaped plaque or lid depicted in a top-down view, featuring an etched or engraved scene inside; the scene contains a ship with sails on a wavy sea, a human figure seated on the left amid the waves, clouds in the sky above, and a lighthouse or tower structure on the right. Both objects are centered within a faintly outlined rectangular border. The drawing is monochromatic, relying on various shades of gray for shading and detail, and includes a handwritten note or signature in the lower left corner.
title: Hand Warmer
